description:
Thirty-eight years on the line. Now I'm here to make sure you're still here when the lights come back on.

I'm Lyle Brannock. I spent my working life as a lineman for a little electric co-op in western Kentucky — ice storms, tornadoes, three hurricanes on mutual aid down on the Gulf — putting the power back on for folks who were cold, scared, or both.

This channel is what I wish every family knew before the lights go out: what to do the moment the power fails, how to stay warm without it, how to run a generator without hurting anybody, and why your street gets its power back when it does. Plain talk, no fear-selling, and every safety claim sourced so you can check me.

New videos every week. If you look after a parent who lives alone, this channel is for you too.

Keep your lights on.
